tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /thar rtse rdo rje 'chang gi sku pur la snyan shal phul ba'i zhal dbyangs// na mo gu ru badzra dhā rā ya/ srab 'jam yang ba shin tu dri zhim pa'i/ /lha rdzas na bza' kha dog sna lnga pa/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams khams kyi mtha' gtugs par/ /bkang ste dpal ldan bla ma mchog la 'bul/ /skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang / /'bral med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod cing / /sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas/ /rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog /skye ba 'di dang ji srid sangs rgyas bar/ /rdo rje 'chang chen dpal ldan bla ma mchog /nam yang 'bral med dad pas rab bsten nas/ /zhal gyi bdud rtsis rtag tu 'tsho bar shog /skye ba kun tu mgon po khyed drung du/ /skyes nas tshul 'dis bdud rtsi legs 'thungs shing / /rkyen ngan 'khor ba'i btson ra kun spangs nas/ skyes mchog khyed dang mtshungs par byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag gi lus srog longs spyod dus gsum gyi/ /dge tshogs ji snyed rje btsun khyed la 'bul/ /tshe rabs kun tu rjes 'dzin rgyur gyur nas/ /gsung gi gsang ba 'dzin pa'i mchog gyur cig /deng 'dir sgo gsum bya ba thams cad kyang / /khyed mnyes bgyid pa gcig pu'i thabs gyur nas/ /rnam thar rgyal mtsho'i rjes su slob mkhas pa'i/ /khyed bstan 'dzin cing spel ba'i mthu ldan shog /khyad par bstan pa'i 'byung khungs gdan sa 'dir/ /lha mi'i bsod nams zhing du mgon khyed kyi/ /sprul pa'i sku mchog myur du 'byon pa dang / /dpal ldan sa skya'i chos srid rgyas byed shog /rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas kyi/ /gsang gsum gcig tu bsdus pa'i rdo rje 'chang / /rgyal ba'i lung bstan kun dga' bzang po yi/ /bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i dge legs stsol// //ces kun blos dad pas phul ba'i yi ge pa ni gzhu lung pa'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/
